title: Fluorescent p53 helix mimetics pairing anticancer and bioimaging properties.
authors: Karmakar, Sintu; Mallik, Mimasha; Sulava, Sushree; Modi, Unnati; Allu, Suryanarayana; Sangwan, Shruti; Tothadi, Srinu; Prakasha Reddy, J; Vasita, Rajesh; Nangia, Ashwini K; Alone, Debasmita Pankaj; Prabhakaran, Panchami
one_liner_zh: 该文研究荧光p53螺旋模拟物抑制p53-HDM2蛋白复合物并兼具抗癌与成像功能，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法仅含分子对接且无AI/物理模拟深度，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Fluorescent therapeutic molecules offer a unique platform to study cellular uptake and biological pathways of drug candidates. Inhibition of the p53-HDM2 protein complex with the reactivation of the p53 pathway leading to apoptosis is a promising way to overcome the barriers and challenges in cancer therapeutic design. Although p53 helix mimetics based on the 'hotspots' design using either helical or non-helical backbones are known, cell-permeable and biocompatible inherently fluorescent helix mimetics have not yet been described. We report theragnostic helix mimetics featuring both therapeutic and bioimaging properties in a cancer cell model for the first time. The solvatochromic phthalimide unit in the scaffold functions as a site to append the hotspot mimicking residues, helps in the intramolecular hydrogen bonding mediated pre-organization of side chains on one face, and importantly, exhibits intrinsic fluorescence. The design of the mimetics, synthesis, conformational studies, and molecular docking results are discussed. In vitro cytotoxicity studies were carried out on four cell lines: U87MG (human glioblastoma), A549 (human non-small cell lung cancer), MDA-MB-231 (human triple-negative breast cancer) and HEK293 (non-cancerous cell line). The molecules showed anticancer activity in the micromolar range. The fluorescence properties provided valuable insights into their cellular permeability, distribution, and selectivity towards cancer cells and can shed light on their mechanisms of action.
abstract_zh: 荧光治疗分子为研究候选药物的细胞摄取和生物通路提供了一个独特的平台。通过抑制p53-HDM2蛋白复合物并重新激活p53通路以诱导细胞凋亡，是克服癌症治疗设计中障碍和挑战的一种有前景的方法。尽管基于“热点”设计、使用螺旋或非螺旋骨架的p53螺旋模拟物已有报道，但具有细胞通透性和生物相容性的固有荧光螺旋模拟物尚未被描述。我们首次在癌细胞模型中报道了兼具治疗和生物成像特性的治疗诊断型螺旋模拟物。骨架中的溶剂变色邻苯二甲酰亚胺单元作为连接热点模拟残基的位点，有助于通过分子内氢键介导的侧链在一侧预组织，并且重要的是，它表现出固有荧光。本文讨论了模拟物的设计、合成、构象研究和分子对接结果。在四种细胞系上进行了体外细胞毒性研究：U87MG（人胶质母细胞瘤）、A549（人非小细胞肺癌）、MDA-MB-231（人三阴性乳腺癌）和HEK293（非癌性细胞系）。这些分子在微摩尔范围内表现出抗癌活性。荧光特性为其细胞通透性、分布和对癌细胞的选择性提供了有价值的见解，并可能揭示其作用机制。
